title.hr: Vatrozid bez stanja i sa stanjem

concept.hr: Odgovor treba zasebno pravilo, osim ako vatrozid pamti vezu
concept.en: The reply needs its own rule, unless the firewall remembers the connection

summary.hr: Klijent pita poslužitelj na portu 443. Vatrozid bez stanja odgovor odbacuje bez zasebnog pravila; sa stanjem ga prepozna. DMZ i dalje prolazi kroz vatrozid.
summary.en: A client asks a server on port 443. A stateless firewall drops the reply without a separate rule; a stateful one knows it. The DMZ still goes through it.
